message:
I’ve always believed in being gloriously over-prepared, especially when it comes to thunderstorms. 🌩️ While I may never win a medal for my storm readiness, I do find comfort in knowing I have a plan — and a stash of batteries, just in case. 

I recently came across a very handy resource that lays out some simple tips and tricks for dealing with thunderstorms and lightning. It’s not about panicking but rather having a calm approach when the skies turn dark. 

So, if you’re like me and prefer to have a little extra peace of mind, it might be worth a look. What’s your go-to tip for staying calm during a storm?
